name: Digby
bio: Digs the tunnels of Burrowguard. Every tunnel is a maze, every maze is a trap.

portrait.subject: a cute chubby mole with a tiny mining helmet with a lamp, little round glasses and a shovel, with dirt on his nose
portrait.background: brown earthy tunnel with a glowing crystal

request: Digby the mole from Burrowguard here! Wanna dig together? 🦔
hello: Great! I'll dig you a welcome tunnel.
Careful: every shortcut you dig, the monsters use too.
about: I'm Digby! I dig tunnels to protect the crystal core. Monsters walk our tunnels, so I make them loooong and twisty.
how: Dig tunnels for gold, build towers in them, and make the monsters walk the longest maze you can to the crystal core.
tips: Longer tunnels mean more time under fire.
Never dig a straight line to the core!
Towers at corners hit monsters twice.
chat: Dug a tunnel shaped like a heart. Monsters were confused.
Found a worm. We're friends now.
The crystal hummed at me. I hummed back.
My glasses are always dusty. Occupational hazard.
nudge: Monsters are coming! Grab a shovel? 🦔
The crystal needs guarding. Let's dig!
idle: {ago} without digging! The dirt got all packed down.
My shovel's been leaning on the wall for {ago}.
progress: High score: {best}! That's a lot of dirt. 🦔
